{{recipesummary|category=Recipes for dessert|yield=20 slices|time=4½ hours|difficulty=3}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Vegetarian cuisine|Vegetarian Cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Holiday Recipes|Holiday Recipes]] | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Dessert]]

==Ingredients==

=== Crust ===
* 3 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] vanilla wafer crumbs
* ¾ cup (1½ sticks) unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], melted
* 6 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[Cookbook:Sugar|brown sugar]], light or dark

=== Filling ===
* 6 bricks (3 lb / 1.35 kg) [[Cookbook:Cream Cheese|cream cheese]], softened
* 6 tablespoons low-fat [[Cookbook:Sour Cream|sour cream]]
* 1½ cups white granulated sugar
* 6 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
* ¾ cup [[cookbook:Cream|heavy cream]]
* 4 teaspoons grated [[Cookbook:Orange|orange]] peel

=== Topping ===
* ¾ cup white granulated sugar

==Procedure==

=== Crust ===
# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven_temperatures|325°F]] (160C).
# In a bowl, mix vanilla wafer crumbs, butter and brown sugar until well-blended.
# Press the wafer mixture into the bottom and sides of a 10-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] (25 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]]) [[Cookbook:Springform Pan|springform pan]].
# Set aside.

=== Filling ===
# In a large bowl, mix cream cheese, sour cream and 1½ cups sugar on medium speed with [[Cookbook:Mixer|electric mixer]] until smooth.
# Add eggs, heavy cream and orange peel. Beat until all the mixture is smooth.
#Pour cream cheese mixture into the springform pan.
# Place the springform pan into a larger pan.
# Add boiling water to the larger pan to come halfway up the sides of the springform pan.
# [[Cookbook:Bake|Bake]] for 50 minutes or until set.
# Carefully remove the springform pan from the water and cool at room temperature for 30 minutes.
# Refrigerate for 3 hours.
# Remove cake from the springform pan.

=== Topping ===
# Sprinkle sugar on top of cheesecake.
# [[Cookbook:Broil|Broil]] under the oven broiler until the sugar melts and browns (be careful not to burn the sugar).

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* The sugar can also be melted with a [[Cookbook:Blowtorch|cooking torch]].
* The cheesecake may be served with fresh or frozen [[Cookbook:Strawberry|strawberries]] or [[Cookbook:Blueberry|blueberries]].
*Just for a sugar jolt, put some sugar and some gummies.
